description: LEGACY HVAC topology for messy_cruise_500. Two coarse cabin AHU networks (port and stbd/central) serve all aggregated cabin blocks. Archived; see docs/PLATFORM_CABIN_REVISION.md for deck-level revision.

hvac_zones.description: Forward public venues and theater complex. High ACH for large assembly.
Midship multi-deck atrium, promenade, and enclosed public spaces.
Aft dining, pool deck, buffet, and recreation venues.
Port-side passenger cabin fresh air supply. 25-30% fresh air fraction to individual fan-coils.
Starboard and Central passenger cabin fresh air supply.
Crew accommodation and messing areas.
Dedicated medical exhaust. Medical Center at 10-12 ACH, Isolation Ward at 12 ACH (100% negative exhaust, HEPA filtered before overboard).
High-volume service exhaust for galleys, laundry, and waste processing.
Engine room forced ventilation and combustion air supply. Massive airflow, non-recirculating to accommodation.
